claims.nodeLabel: H.R. 6967 - Safe Airspace for Americans Act (118th Congress)
claims.text: Intended to close the gap in UAP reporting by enabling civilian pilots and personnel to report encounters to the FAA, which would send reports to AARO, in exchange for legal safeguards.
